categories.name: docs
categories.evidence: Matches the 'Docs' label and updates doc/release-notes-empty-template.md.
categories.rationale: Corrects inaccurate upgrade instructions in the release notes template that could leave multiprocess helper binaries stale on Linux. Per the PR description and issue #36431, copying only `bitcoind`/`bitcoin-qt` leaves `libexec/` binaries outdated after the introduction of the `bitcoin` wrapper.
